marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 无终仙境 | Wu zhong xian jing

I lived with Cui Dali in Tiaoshui Hutong. My great-great-grandfather once went beyond the Great Wall to dig for ginseng and became sworn brothers with Cui Dali’s ancestor, the Taoist priest Cui Laodao. All the tales about our ancestors from Tianjin Wei were told to me by Cui Dali. But he often exaggerated, saying things like “A spark misfired at Huayang Palace lit a thousand miles,” or “Dragon-Pinch Mountain crushed Dou Zhanlong,” making it all sound incredibly real. It wasn’t until one time, when Stinky Fish, Cui Dali, and I were keeping vigil for a deceased neighbor, that we discovered a coffin under the southwest room—only then did I realize that some of Cui Dali’s wild stories were actually not far from the truth…
